summary: Carla cannot be pulled free. The inner gate breaks, Wall Maria is lost, and Eren's grief turns into a vow he does not yet know how to carry.

segments.ja: カルラは、崩れた家の材木の下で足を取れません。取れない母を、エレンとミカサは手で起こそうとします。起こそうとする力は、子供の力です。子供の力では、梁は動きません。動かない梁のあいだで、カルラは二人の顔を見ます。見る顔に、彼女は生き延びろと置きます。置く言葉は、一緒に来い、ではありません。ではありません。母は、自分を残して走れと言います。言う声は、市場の朝と同じ声です。
segments.en: Carla cannot pull her legs free under the timber of the collapsed house. Eren and Mikasa try to lift their mother with their hands. The strength that tries to lift her is a child's strength. A child's strength does not move the beam. Between the beams that do not move, Carla looks at their two faces. Onto the faces she looks at, she places the words live. The words she places are not come with me. They are not. Their mother tells them to run and leave her. The voice that says it is the same voice as the market morning.

segments.ja: エレンは、母の命令を拒みます。拒む理由は、家族を材木の下に置いて逃げることが、人間のすることではない、です。ではない主張を、ミカサも手で支えます。支える二人の前に、巨人の足音が近づきます。近づく音を、ハンネスは背中で聞きます。聞いた彼は、もう一度刃を考えることをやめます。やめた判断で、子供を両腕に固定します。固定されたエレンは、母の顔が遠ざかるのを見ます。
segments.en: Eren refuses his mother's order. The reason he refuses is that leaving family under timber and running is not something a person does. Mikasa supports with her hands the claim that it is not. In front of the two who support it, a Titan's footsteps come closer. Hannes hears the approaching sound with his back. After hearing it, he stops thinking about the blade again. With the judgment he stopped, he locks the children into both arms. The locked Eren watches his mother's face grow distant.

segments.ja: 材木のそばまで来た巨人は、急いでいません。急がない顔は、笑っているように見えます。見える笑顔は、優しさではありません。ではありません。口が開くまでの、空白の時間です。空白の中で、カルラは子供の名を呼びません。呼ばないことが、巨人の注意を自分に残す最後の工夫です。工夫のあと、街の音が一つ消えます。消えた音を、エレンは後まで忘れません。忘れない絵が、その日の中心です。中心は、ヒーローの勝利ではありません。
segments.en: The Titan that comes up beside the timber is not hurrying. The face that does not hurry looks as if it is smiling. The smile that can be seen is not kindness. It is not. It is the blank time until the mouth opens. Inside the blank, Carla does not call the children's names. Not calling is her last device for keeping the Titan's attention on herself. After the device, one sound disappears from the town. Eren does not forget the disappeared sound afterward. The picture he does not forget is the center of that day. The center is not a hero's victory.

segments.ja: ハンネスは、振り返ることを自分に禁じます。禁じたまま、内門の方向へ走ります。走る道は、朝に子供と笑った道です。笑った道に、今は逃げ遅れた人がいます。いる人を、彼は全員は救えません。救えない限界を、腕の中の二人が見ています。見ているエレンは、兵士を信用する気持ちを失いかけます。失いかける気持ちの横で、ミカサは無言です。無言の彼女は、すでに別の日に家族を失っています。失った経験が、今日の足を止めません。
segments.en: Hannes forbids himself to look back. While the forbid holds, he runs toward the inner gate. The road he runs is the road where he laughed with the children in the morning. On the road where he laughed, there are now people who are late to flee. He cannot save every person who is there. The two in his arms are watching the limit of what he cannot save. The Eren who is watching is close to losing his trust in soldiers. Beside the feeling he is close to losing, Mikasa is silent. She, silent, has already lost a family on another day. The experience of having lost does not stop her feet today.

segments.en: The inner gate is still open, letting boats and people through. While it lets them through, the depth of Shiganshina can still be protected. The time it can be protected is short. The reason it is short is that another Titan appears on this side of the wall. The body that appears is not ordinary skin. It is not skin. It is covered in hard plates. The covered Titan runs toward the inner gate. The speed of the running differs from the smile of a moment ago. The different speed turns the fleeing line into panic.

segments.en: The hard Titan strikes the inner gate with its whole body. With the shock of the strike, Shiganshina becomes a town of holes completely. Once it becomes that, this district of Wall Maria is no longer a place for people. Boats leave that place toward the inner wall. Eren, Mikasa, and Armin board a boat that leaves. The three who board hold the same loss at the same hour. The name of the loss they hold is home. Home includes the timber, their mother, and the riverbank of the book. All of what it includes is left beyond the gate.

segments.en: On the boat, people put the wall's name in their mouths. The fact they put there is that Wall Maria has fallen. Inside the fallen wall, Rose and Sina are still there. The two walls that are there are the world from now on. The world is narrower than yesterday. Shiganshina's population pushes into the narrow world. The Garrison looks down from the inner wall at the line that pushes in. Among the soldiers who look, the figure of Keith, who will later lead the training, is mixed. He, mixed in, looks once at the heat in a boy's eyes.

segments.en: Beside Eren, Mikasa straightens her scarf. The motion of straightening is a continuation of the day, long ago, when he brought her home. The cloth of the continuation gets dirty with today's blood and dust. She does not throw away the dirty cloth. The reason she does not throw it away is that this cloth stands in for family. Under the cloth that stands in, she counts Eren's breaths. Counting is a way not to cry. The way does not erase the guilt of not having been able to help his mother. Without erasing it, she stays with him as far as the next wall.

segments.en: When the boat reaches the inner wall, many faces look down from above. The faces that look down are a mix of help, fear, and calculation. The mixed calculation is whether this many people can be fed. That question becomes politics in the next episode. Before it becomes politics, today there is only the landing. At the landing that there is, Eren is still calling his mother's name. The voice he calls is swallowed by the wall and does not return. Not returning is the confirmation of death. He changes the confirmation, quickly, into words of revenge.

segments.ja: その日は、一つの悲しい出来事ではありません。ではありません。夢の涙と、空の鞍と、砕かれた門と、材木と、内門と、舟と、鍵が、同じ午後に積まれます。積まれた層を、エレンはまだ順番に理解できません。できないまま、彼は怒りだけを表面に出します。出す怒りの下に、母の声が残っています。残っている声は、逃げろ、です。逃げろ、を、彼は聞けなかった自分への罰として持ちます。持つ罰が、これからの三年を押します。
segments.en: That day is not one sad event. It is not. The dream's tears, the empty saddles, the broken gate, the timber, the inner gate, the boat, and the key are stacked in the same afternoon. Eren cannot yet understand the stacked layers in order. Without being able to, he puts only anger on the surface. Under the anger he puts out, his mother's voice remains. The voice that remains is run. He carries run as a punishment toward himself, the self that could not hear it. The punishment he carries pushes the next three years.

The reason it is short is that another Titan appears on this side of the wall. The body that appears is not ordinary skin. It is not skin. It is covered in hard plates. The covered Titan runs toward the inner gate. The speed of the running differs from the smile of a moment ago. The different speed turns the fleeing line into panic.

vocab.exampleJa: 直後の沈黙を、三人は分けます。
vocab.exampleEn: Armin is also on this boat, separated from his grandparents. He does not have the book of the sea as luggage. The imagination he does not have looks cruel today. The cruelty that can be seen is that the outside world was not salt water. He does not yet tell Eren the fact that it was not. The reason he does not tell it is that his friend has just lost his mother. The three share the silence of just after. The silence they share is the first contract of the squad from here on. The contract is not words.

vocab.exampleJa: 近づく音を、ハンネスは背中で聞きます。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren refuses his mother's order. The reason he refuses is that leaving family under timber and running is not something a person does. Mikasa supports with her hands the claim that it is not. In front of the two who support it, a Titan's footsteps come closer. Hannes hears the approaching sound with his back. After hearing it, he stops thinking about the blade again. With the judgment he stopped, he locks the children into both arms. The locked Eren watches his mother's face grow distant.

vocab.exampleJa: 見ているエレンは、兵士を信用する気持ちを失いかけます。
vocab.exampleEn: Hannes forbids himself to look back. While the forbid holds, he runs toward the inner gate. The road he runs is the road where he laughed with the children in the morning. On the road where he laughed, there are now people who are late to flee. He cannot save every person who is there. The two in his arms are watching the limit of what he cannot save. The Eren who is watching is close to losing his trust in soldiers. Beside the feeling he is close to losing, Mikasa is silent. She, silent, has already lost a family on another day. The experience of having lost does not stop her feet today.

vocab.exampleJa: 呼ぶ声は、壁に吸い込まれて返ってきません。
vocab.exampleEn: When the boat reaches the inner wall, many faces look down from above. The faces that look down are a mix of help, fear, and calculation. The mixed calculation is whether this many people can be fed. That question becomes politics in the next episode. Before it becomes politics, today there is only the landing. At the landing that there is, Eren is still calling his mother's name. The voice he calls is swallowed by the wall and does not return. Not returning is the confirmation of death. He changes the confirmation, quickly, into words of revenge.

vocab.exampleJa: カルラは、崩れた家の材木の下で足を取れません。
vocab.exampleEn: Carla cannot pull her legs free under the timber of the collapsed house. Eren and Mikasa try to lift their mother with their hands. The strength that tries to lift her is a child's strength. A child's strength does not move the beam. Between the beams that do not move, Carla looks at their two faces. Onto the faces she looks at, she places the words live. The words she places are not come with me. They are not. Their mother tells them to run and leave her. The voice that says it is the same voice as the market morning.

vocab.exampleJa: 数えることが、泣かない方法です。
vocab.exampleEn: Beside Eren, Mikasa straightens her scarf. The motion of straightening is a continuation of the day, long ago, when he brought her home. The cloth of the continuation gets dirty with today's blood and dust. She does not throw away the dirty cloth. The reason she does not throw it away is that this cloth stands in for family. Under the cloth that stands in, she counts Eren's breaths. Counting is a way not to cry. The way does not erase the guilt of not having been able to help his mother. Without erasing it, she stays with him as far as the next wall.

vocab.exampleJa: 消えた音を、エレンは後まで忘れません。
vocab.exampleEn: The Titan that comes up beside the timber is not hurrying. The face that does not hurry looks as if it is smiling. The smile that can be seen is not kindness. It is not. It is the blank time until the mouth opens. Inside the blank, Carla does not call the children's names. Not calling is her last device for keeping the Titan's attention on herself. After the device, one sound disappears from the town. Eren does not forget the disappeared sound afterward. The picture he does not forget is the center of that day. The center is not a hero's victory.

vocab.exampleJa: 家は、材木と、母と、本の川岸を含みます。
vocab.exampleEn: The hard Titan strikes the inner gate with its whole body. With the shock of the strike, Shiganshina becomes a town of holes completely. Once it becomes that, this district of Wall Maria is no longer a place for people. Boats leave that place toward the inner wall. Eren, Mikasa, and Armin board a boat that leaves. The three who board hold the same loss at the same hour. The name of the loss they hold is home. Home includes the timber, their mother, and the riverbank of the book. All of what it includes is left beyond the gate.

vocab.exampleJa: 置かれた空白を、誰もその場では埋めません。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren does not search the fleeing line for Grisha. He does not. His father had gone out for the clinic since morning. Partway through, the boy learns that the father who had gone out is not at the collapsed house. The blank he learns is placed beside the loss of his mother. Nobody fills the placed blank on the spot. On the night nobody fills it, Eren repeats fever and sleep. After the sleep he repeats, there is a key in his hand. Which door the key belongs to is not yet said.

vocab.exampleEn: Today's words. On that day, Carla cannot move from under the timber. A smiling Titan takes the mother who cannot move. Hannes runs to the inner gate carrying the children. The door of the remaining key is still unnamed. The unnamed loss continues into the next training.

vocab.exampleJa: 持たないまま、彼は駐屯の仕事に戻ります。
vocab.exampleEn: After carrying the children as far as the inner wall, Hannes looks at his own feet. The feet he looks at stopped in front of a Titan. The work he returns to is protecting the next gate. The role of protecting has failed today. The man who failed still remains near the children. Remaining is the cleanup after a rescue that was not complete.

vocab.note: Eren's vow after the flight. It is grief given a direction, not a plan that already works.
vocab.exampleJa: エレンの誓いは、長い作戦ではありません。
vocab.exampleEn: Eren's vow is not a long operation. It is not. It is only a direction: erase every Titan, and leave none. He puts only that direction into words in front of Armin and Mikasa. The moment he puts it there, grief borrows the shape of anger. The borrowed anger is still the anger of a child who knows neither a blade nor a regiment. The two of them do not deny the anger he does not know. Not denying it is the dangerous side of friendship. Even on the dangerous side, they receive those words today.
